sites.name: Shackleton
sites.coord_note: Gazetteer gives 89.9S 0E, which lies on the rim next to the pole; the floor is not there. Centre here = centroid of Diviner annual-max <110 K pixels within 15 km of the pole (checked: also near the deepest LOLA DEM point, -89.63 / 118.8E). Verify against a published crater centre.
